svg.title: sql-mcp semantic authoring layout
svg.text: sql-mcp authoring - one target, three columns plus a detail pane
Join diagram is browse-only. Select stack reorders. Edits write meta JSON.
A. Physical - table names left, mapping on the right
and not in the bottom pane.
No column list in this pane.
Query field picker is a separate screen and is not drawn here.
Bottom edits the selected table document. It does not repeat the mapping grid.
Switch to Cubes to combine views. This pane then follows that selection.
B. Cubes - combine on the left, cube tree on the right
Same target. Outside views are hidden.
Select a view in this list
or segment to edit it below.
Role groups stay separate: dimensions, facts, then metrics, then segments.
Metric and segment rows stay disabled until the cube has dimensions and facts.
Query picker still hides metric and segment names. They are not columns.
C. Select view - priority stack in the center, column merge on the right
Opened when combine is select. Same target only.
Top of the stack is priority 1. Bottom is lowest.
Dragging changes order only. It does not edit columns.
same pattern as the join-view mapping
+ map another column from the stacked views
Empty cells stay empty. Higher priority fills the output first.
Writes meta JSON for this view. Stack order and column merge are the fields above.
Column edits stay on the right.
